title: rdp: many improvements and fixes

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • c680b00a - rdp: many improvements and fixes
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3301/diffs?diff_id=198776332&start_sha=53ba6426ccb8d718e506a6a1d00c7199cdbc1dac)
Yeah that's typos copied from the spec, but I can correct them if needed.
Ok will have a look, I didn't know this function.

I gave a look and `tvb_get_varint` doesn't look appropriate as in my case the `len` field is located in various places (as you have some PDUs that have both a length coded in `Sp` and `CbId` for the `ChannelId` and `Length` fields).

Just look at this packet https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/windows_protocols/ms-rdpedyc/69377767-56a6-4ab8-996b-7758676e9261: ChannelId and Length are variable length integers, but the length in bytes is encoded in two different locations in the first byte of the packet. That would mean that I would have to add 2 new VARINT encodings, not sure there's a gain here.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/3301/diffs?diff_id=199320064&start_sha=c680b00a0ff931a20a15549f772a15c4c95ba80d#bccd3010e2600c11d3a3893ff8c56658063772cd_316_317)

can you fix also
packet-rdp_drdynvc.c:378 proto_tree_add_item called for hf_rdp_drdynvc_softsync_req_flags  -  item type is FT_UINT8 but call has len 2
